parsed.name: revision_flow_leaders_global
parsed.strategy: Bet on the strongest 90-day analyst revision flow, not on target-level upside: 24 names where net target raises came from at least three distinct firms, concentrated in software (OKTA, SNOW, CRWD, PANW, CRM, GTLB, ESTC, NET, DDOG, WDAY, S, DT, ZS, MDB), large-cap pharma (MRK, ABBV, AMGN, LLY, ARGX), semis (NVDA, AMD, ASML, TSM) and AME. Every name has a Q3 print or PDUFA inside the Oct 12-Nov 13 window, so relative P&L is driven by real events. I would be wrong if the revision flow was already fully priced and the prints sell off on beats, or if a single AI-capex digestion headline hits the correlated software/semis sleeve at once.

strategy.brief: Analyst revision flow: names with the strongest 90-day net target RAISES across >= 3 distinct firms. The flow, not the target level (target-level upside is measured perverse). Competition rules: long only, global, <= 10% per name, >= 8 names, NO ETFs, cash <= 2%, graded as relative P&L vs the Bloomberg WLS index from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13.
